aliases: Use exact endpoint-ledger aliases, no public reflection
startup: backend.domains.projects.register_jobs() once; Messaging owns worker lifecycle
transaction: Single caller-owned synchronous SQLAlchemy Connection throughout; do not independently commit

cross_domain.files: search.sync outbox; files_collaboration.resolve_attachment_path/format_file_data; index.to_preview_url; Files owns project_task_files insertion from upload
cross_domain.accounts: managed_departments/department_users; account_common.upsert; account_meetings.bot_get (independent identity owner replaces vendor gate); projects.transfer_user_memberships

integration_test_precondition: DOOTASK_PROJECT_TEST_TOKENS JSON array of three real locally-created test-user tokens; first admin; isolated MariaDB/Redis schema installed; rollback all business writes
external_acceptance_requirements: AI provider config and installed app metadata
source_import_boundary: No project/task import in 75 assigned Project/Handoff handlers; users/import endpoints belong to Accounts; no invented route
verification: NOT_RUN; static evidence generation only, no imports/build/tests/lint/formatter/services
